Actor Imran Khan Issued Leave India Notice After Protest

Actor Imran Khan has been issued a notice by the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) to leave India by October 28. The notice alleges that Khan violated the Foreigners Act by participating in a protest at August Kranti Maidan on October 10, where participants demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar. Khan is identified as the nephew of actor Aamir Khan.
